Read from page images by Agent 3 (batch 10 q199) for 1974: complete list of 15 Aug 1974 (No. 33) - no Southern Rhodesian cholera area; newly infected 4 Sep 1974 (No. 36) 'SOUTHERN RHODESIA Manicaland Chipinga District'; complete list 12 Sep 1974 (No. 37 p.313) 'Manicaland: Chipinga District' only; newly infected 26 Sep 1974 (No. 39 p.331) 'Victoria Province: Chiredzi District'; complete lists 10 Oct 1974 (No. 41 p.345) and 7 Nov 1974 (No. 45 p.378) 'Manicaland: Chipinga District; Victoria Province: Chiredzi District'; newly infected lists of 21 and 28 Nov 1974 (Nos. 47-48) contain no Rhodesian area; complete list 5 Dec 1974 (No. 49 p.409) 'Manicaland: Chipinga District; Mashonaland: x Darwin District [newly reported]; Victoria Province: Chiredzi District, Nuanetsi District'; newly infected 19 Dec 1974 (No. 51/52 p.432) 'Victoria Province: Chibi District'. 1975-1976 lists as transcribed in sources 375 and 376 (cholera-infected districts only in Manicaland - Chipinga, Buhera, Umtali; Mashonaland - Darwin, Bindura; Victoria Province - Chibi, Chiredzi, Nuanetsi, Victoria, Bikita, Ndanga). The Matabeleland (Wankie, Lupane, Nkai) and Midlands (Gwelo) entries in these issues are in the PLAGUE list, not cholera.
